result.topic_en: Formula-only calculations for minimal surfaces: a Riemann P-function solution with exponents ±γ/2 in √t, a logarithmic substitution yielding explicit coordinates X, Y, Z (a catenoid-type surface), and, below the rule, algebraic work on Möbius-type transformations t' of t that preserve the radical √((1+t²)(1+κ²t²)) and the points t=0, i, i/κ.

$P\begin{pmatrix} 0 & 0 & -\frac{\gamma}{2} \\ \frac{1}{2} & \frac{1}{2} & -\frac{\gamma}{2} \end{pmatrix} t \Big) =$

$\frac{du}{d\log\eta}=\sqrt{\frac{2C}{\gamma''}}$

$Y=-\frac{i}{2}\frac{2C}{\gamma''}\int\left(\eta-\frac{1}{\eta}\right)\frac{d\eta}{\eta}$
$Y=-\frac{i}{2}\frac{2C}{\gamma''}\left(\eta+\frac{1}{\eta}\right)$
$Z=-\frac{1}{2}\frac{2C}{\gamma''}\left(\eta-\frac{1}{\eta}\right)$

methods.what: Riemann P-function with exponents 0, 1/2 and ±γ/2 solved by powers of (1-√t)/(1+√t)
Logarithmic substitution relating the parameter u to log η
Explicit coordinate functions of a minimal surface (catenoid type) obtained by integration in η
Resulting closed form for the coordinate Y
Resulting closed form for the coordinate Z
Resulting closed form for the coordinate X
Quadratic relations between t and t' solved by the quadratic formula
Transformation t' of t involving the radical √((1+t²)(1+κ²t²)), with fixed points t=0, i, i/κ
Invariance condition on the ratio (1+t²)/(1+κ²t²) under t→t'
Discriminant condition for the coefficients A, B, C
